State university in Rome: €300 to €1,500 a year

Sapienza charges non-EU students living abroad €300, €700 or €1,500 a year, depending on country of residence (2026/27). On the fee table, Türkiye is in group B: €700 a year (with income from abroad). Confirm 2027/28.

Source: uniroma1.it (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Non-EU bachelor's fees: from Delft to Rotterdam

TU Delft: €20,563 (BSc, institutional fee)
Erasmus Univ. College: €17,800 (non-EU institutional fee)
Leiden (lowest): €14,700 (science €19,200, medicine €31,400)
Erasmus Rotterdam: €14,700 (RSM €15,200, medicine €35,000)
Statutory fee (EU/EEA): €2,771 (EU/EEA passport holders)

2027/28 fees. At Leiden and Rotterdam they rise by subject. On a Turkish passport, the institutional rate usually applies.

Source: tudelft.nl, universiteitleiden.nl, eur.nl (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Mannheim has no single IELTS score

IELTS ranges from 5.5 to 7.0 by master's program: Data Science and Economics 6.0, Social Data Science 6.5, Management and Finance 7.0. TOEFL iBT equivalents range from 72 to 100. Check your own program's page.

Source: uni-mannheim.de (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

“You cannot apply in Italy without a Dichiarazione di Valore”

The truth: CIMEA documents are also an option. For your diploma, the circular says CIMEA (equivalence center) documents or a Dichiarazione di Valore from the consulate. The university chooses, so ask first.

Source: unife.it, poliba.it, univr.it (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Verona: a flat €1,000 option if you have no income certificate

info.text:
Applying on Common App: a five-part summary

1. Gather your documents: High school transcript, activities, test scores if you have them, family details. Your school counselor sends the School Report.
2. Open an account, add schools: You can open an account any time. The 2026-27 season has more than 1,200 member institutions.
3. Invite your recommenders: Each university sets its own recommendation requirements: counselor, teacher, sometimes a coach or employer.
4. Essays: Personal essay: required at some schools, optional at others. There may also be school-specific questions and a writing supplement.
5. Submit: Each university has its own deadline. Testing policy (required or optional) also varies by school.

The UC system uses its own application. UT Austin accepts both Common App and ApplyTexas.

Source: commonapp.org, admission.universityofcalifornia.edu, admissions.utexas.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Münster: €369.50 semester contribution, no tuition

The University of Münster charges no tuition. The semester contribution for winter 2026/27 is €369.50, about €739 a year. Covers public transport too and is updated every semester. Rent and living costs are separate.

Source: uni-muenster.de (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
